subject: 3d: Reap agent on POST /sweep route too — extract shared reapAgent helper across all releaseClaim sites
description:
Follow-up to 3c (note:note-mqeo3v9kn6i, "SPEC IS INCOMPLETE: sweep endpoint also needs agent reap"). 3c made sweepStaleClaims reap the owning agent running→stale on release, but the manual POST /sweep HTTP route (routes/meta.js, both the force and non-force branches, ~lines 57-74) calls releaseClaim directly and does NOT reap the agent — so an operator/test-triggered sweep leaves the agent 'running' until the independent 60s sweepStaleAgents pass catches it.

FIX: extract a shared reapAgent(agentId) helper (in daemon.js, alongside releaseClaim) that transitions a running agent → terminal 'stale' with endedAt, and call it from ALL releaseClaim sites: the sweepStaleClaims loop (refactor 3c's inline logic to use the helper — keep behavior identical) AND both branches of the POST /sweep route in routes/meta.js. Use the existing vouchedLive/staleClaimKeys liveness basis; only reap agents whose claim is actually being released. Minor consistency note from 3c: sweepStaleClaims reaps to 'stale' while sweepStaleAgents reaps to 'dead' — both non-running so harmless; keep 'stale' for the release-coupled reap, do not churn sweepStaleAgents.

Add a unit test proving a POST /sweep release drops the agent out of the /health running count. Run the full suite green vs base (~15-16 known pre-existing sandbox failures — compare, don't expect 0). Daemon restart needed to activate — add as disruptive follow_up, do not restart yourself.
